task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Alert' window in iDempiere.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The iDempiere window title or tab shows 'Alert' and the standard alert configuration fields are visible.

task_completion.description: Set the Alert Name to 'High Value Purchase' and Alert Subject to 'Review Invoice > 1000'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Name' field contains 'High Value Purchase' and the 'Alert Subject' field contains 'Review Invoice > 1000' in the Alert header tab.

task_completion.description: Ensure the 'Enforce Client Security' checkbox is selected.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Enforce Client Security' checkbox is checked (ticked) in the Alert window.

task_completion.description: Create an Alert Rule with the specific SQL SELECT clause for vendor invoices > 1000.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 'Alert Rule' tab, the 'Select Clause' or 'From Clause' fields contain 'SELECT * FROM C_Invoice' and the 'Where Clause' contains "IsSOTrx='N' AND DocStatus='CO' AND GrandTotal > 1000".
In the 'Alert Recipient' tab, a record is visible where the User/Contact is set to 'GardenAdmin'.
The 'Save' icon is clicked/greyed out, or a 'Saved' status message appears in the bottom status bar.

integrity.description: The agent used the iDempiere web interface rather than direct database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the iDempiere UI elements and form fields.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the SQL and names rather than using a script to bypass the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the text being typed or pasted into the specific iDempiere text fields.

integrity.description: The agent is working within the GardenWorld client environment.
integrity.visual_evidence: The iDempiere status bar or login info shows 'GardenWorld' as the active Client/Organization.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The alert must be named 'High Value Purchase' with subject 'Review Invoice > 1000'. The SQL rule must target the 'C_Invoice' table with the specific filters: IsSOTrx='N' (Vendor), DocStatus='CO' (Completed), and GrandTotal > 1000. The recipient must be the user 'GardenAdmin'. Client Security must be enabled.
